mercs.name: Mara Ilesh
mercs.bio: Commanded a supply company until Karsa made her a rearguard. Counts her people every night; the number is the only prayer she has left.
mercs.wound: Reported her old company at strength for a year, knowing it was empty.

samples: Four on my left. Four on my right. Good.
Nobody goes on the ledger who is not on the ship.
I will sleep when the number stops changing.

relationships.note: She needs his honesty and fears it.
Gran was her sergeant first.
She let the girl stay.

arc.beat: Orders the breakout and signs the first false roll herself.
Reads the first name aloud.
Learns what the Roll really is.
Decides what the squad becomes at the door.

mercs.death_line: Count them again. I think I lost one.
mercs.hollow_note: Its hands still count to four before it fires.

mercs.name: Tobias Quill
mercs.bio: A Muster Officer who audited the Roll and found the dead outnumber the living nine to one. Carries the ledger on a slate and cannot put it down.
mercs.wound: Signed the Article Nine reports for three years.

samples: For the record, we are fourteen companies. For the record, that is untrue.
A number is not a mercy. It only looks like one.
I can tell you how many. I cannot tell you who.

relationships.note: He gives her the truth in small doses.
They keep the names between them.
A bureaucrat knows a bureaucrat.

arc.beat: Hides what the Roll says.
Confesses to the Warden what the vats are for.
Opens the ledger to the whole squad.

mercs.death_line: Put it in the record. Put me in the record.
mercs.hollow_note: It carries the slate and never opens it.

mercs.name: Rennick Aldous
mercs.bio: Grew up on a lamp-keeper's dock and learned to read distance by light. Jokes softly to keep the dark at a distance.
mercs.wound: Cannot sleep with the lights off.

samples: Lights on the left. Not ours.
I would tell a joke, but the room is sad enough already.
Keep one lantern lit. I do not care what it costs.

relationships.note: Found family; he talks so she does not have to.
He calls her the fastest coward alive.

arc.beat: Leads them through the wreck-field by lantern light.
Finds a working lamp and cannot stop looking at it.

mercs.death_line: Leave the light on, would you.
mercs.hollow_note: It never blinks at a bright light.

mercs.name: Sable Okonkwo
mercs.bio: Grieves in precise units: one breath, one shot, one name. Rarely speaks outside a scope.
mercs.wound: Her twin died at Ostrava; their slot was refilled within the week.

samples: Distance is two-forty. Breathe.
I keep a tally. It is not kind.
Do not read his name over that thing. It is not him.

relationships.note: He fills her silences.
He would read the names; she would not.
Both listen for what others cannot hear.

arc.beat: Refuses the first Roll Call.
Finds her brother's slot number in the vats.
Reads one hull's name aloud.

mercs.hollow_note: It holds its breath exactly as long as she did.

mercs.name: Dov Karelian
mercs.bio: Carries the squad's heaviest kit and its heaviest silences. Protects without being asked.
mercs.wound: Carried his dying brother four kilometres; the hollow that replaced him was waiting at the muster.

samples: I have it. Go.
The weight is not the problem.
Stand behind me. It is the only thing I am good for.

relationships.note: He keeps her behind him and she hates it.
He does what she says without a word.

arc.beat: Shields a family and is badly hurt.
Holds the door alone.

mercs.hollow_note: It stands in doorways and does not step aside.

mercs.name: Ines Valcourt
mercs.bio: Hears the Tether net as a hum under the teeth. Can tell, within a word, when someone is speaking in their own voice.
mercs.wound: Her own Tether implant was never removed.

samples: It is a hum. It is always a hum. Listen.
That was not a person. That was a procedure.
I can cut one tether. Just one. Choose.

relationships.note: Both listen for what others cannot hear.
She hears no hum in him.
He kept her implant off the Roll.

arc.beat: Learns she can cut a single hollow's tether.
Jams the gate's net long enough.
Holds the key that stops every hollow at once.

mercs.hollow_note: It hums at the same pitch she does.

mercs.name: Yusuf Adeyemi-Roth
mercs.bio: Learned a hundred and twelve names in the first week and has not lost one since. Treats the wounded and the dead with the same patience.
mercs.wound: Believes the names are all that is left of anyone.

tics: says the name before the prayer
samples: Say the name. Say it once. That is all.
I will not tell you it will be alright. I will tell you I am here.
Three hundred and four. I have them all.

relationships.note: They keep the names between them.
He would read the names; she would not.

arc.beat: Insists on the first Roll Call.
Tends eighty wounded under fire.

mercs.hollow_note: It does not answer to its name.

mercs.name: Calla Voss
mercs.bio: Twenty, fast and furious, and treats every locked door as a personal insult. Hides fear under speed.

samples: A door is a door. Stand back.
Do not tell me to be careful. Careful is how Dov got hurt.
I am not scared. I am fast.

relationships.note: He keeps her behind him and she hates it.
He calls her the fastest coward alive.
She cannot forgive where he came from.

arc.beat: Breaches the first door.
Chooses mercy over speed.

mercs.hollow_note: It breaches without hesitation, which is how you know.

mercs.name: Anneliese Brandt
mercs.bio: Fifty-eight, has lost one war already and is not interested in a second. Teaches the young how to be afraid usefully.
mercs.wound: Commanded a company at Ostrava; it was reported at strength the day after it died.

samples: Fear is fine. Fear is a tool. Use it.
I have buried this army once.
We walk. Walking is all a retreat is.

relationships.note: Her former subordinate now gives the orders.
She teaches her to be afraid on purpose.
Two people who remember the old books.

arc.beat: Teaches the squad to move in fog.
Meets the hollows of her old company.

mercs.death_line: Walk. Do not stop to count me.

mercs.name: Kit Marrow
mercs.bio: Keeps the books on every bullet and bandage, and a private ledger of bad jokes. Treats supply as the last honest art.

samples: We have twenty-one reserves. I counted twice. Still twenty-one.
Every round is a promise. Spend slowly.
Do not thank me. Thank the accountant who lost the war.

relationships.note: Two people who remember the old books.
They signed the first false roll together.
Two ledgers, one truth.

arc.beat: Finds the muster drop manifest and reads it twice.
Rigs the gate frame to hold.

mercs.hollow_note: It issues ammunition with perfect indifference.

mercs.name: Oriel Vance
mercs.bio: Served the Retrieval Bureau for nine years and left the night a counting went wrong. Knows how Orrick thinks because Orrick taught the course.
mercs.wound: Helped count a village into a register.

samples: He will be polite. He is always polite. That is the danger.
You cannot outrun a procedure. You can only be inconvenient.
I used to read the lists. Now I read the faces.

relationships.note: She hears no hum in them.
She cannot forgive where they came from.
A bureaucrat knows a bureaucrat.

arc.beat: Joins the squad with a stolen ledger.
Names the secret of Orrick's missing past.

mercs.hollow_note: It speaks only in procedural phrases.

mercs.name: Wren Haldane
mercs.bio: Seventeen, the youngest voice in a squad of tired ones. Joined to carry her mother's name and refuses to go back.
mercs.wound: Her mother is on the Roll as living.

samples: I can carry that. Give it here.
You keep saying careful. Careful is not a plan.
My mother's name is on the list. Is she dead, or just counted?

relationships.note: She let the girl stay.
He teaches her the stars.
He is the only one who answers her honestly.

arc.beat: Walks out with the squad carrying a name that is not hers.
Reads the Roll and finds her mother.

mercs.death_line: Read it right. Her name first.
mercs.hollow_note: It carries a name it cannot say.
